Thanks Hannah — quick answers below and attaching our redlined MSA for your reference.

1) Primary Redwood signatory will be: Jordan Blake, Chief Business Officer — authorized to sign both the MSA and Order Form on behalf of Redwood Inference. If your procurement requires a separate signature for the Order Form, let us know and we can arrange the alternate signatory (Priya Natarajan, VP Legal) to be added as secondary.

2) ID proofing: Redwood can accept standard DocuSign email authentication + access code. 3) Routing: we prefer Redwood countersign first (sequential) so you receive an executed copy immediately after your signature. However, we can flip to parallel signing if you have internal reasons to collect the OF first. Our recommended default: Redwood signs MSA (or both docs) first, then Acme signs Order Form.
